description: Compute the end of a period ('within 30 calendar days', '10 working days', '3 months') from a start date under explicit counting rules, roll it by the chosen convention when it lands on a non-working day, and return raw vs final deadline, skipped days and a step-by-step explanation plus a disclaimer. Pass the rules the contract/law states; defaults are the common ones. Example: start_date '2026-11-26', period 7, unit 'calendar_days', country 'GB'. Calendar selection: country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. 'SA', 'DE', 'US') or market (MIC, e.g. 'XNYS', 'XLON'); optional subdivision (state/province/emirate code from list_calendars), categories (e.g. ['public','bank']), weekend override (['FRI','SAT']), extra_holidays (company/contract dates). Weekend defaults to the country's legal weekend. Response: result plus data_confidence (high = fixed-date calendar; medium = a lunar/moon-sighted or projected holiday is involved, or the caller overrode the weekend), estimated_items[] naming each projected date, sources[] (public references behind the calendar), data_version and warnings[].

categories.description: Holiday categories to count as non-working; default ['public']. Others per country: bank, government, school, optional, half_day, catholic…
categories.title: Categories

convention.description: What to do when the raw deadline lands on a non-working day. Default following (roll to the next working day); 'none' leaves it.
convention.title: Convention

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Required unless market is given.
country.title: Country

exclude_start_day.description: Day 1 is the day after start_date (true, the common convention) or start_date itself (false).
exclude_start_day.title: Exclude Start Day

extra_holidays.description: Additional non-working ISO dates (company closures, contract-specific days).
extra_holidays.title: Extra Holidays

include_estimated_holidays.description: Count projected lunar/moon-sighted holidays as non-working (true) or ignore them until announced (false).
include_estimated_holidays.title: Include Estimated Holidays

language.description: Language for holiday names where available (e.g. 'ar', 'de', 'en_US'). Default: the country's own.
language.title: Language

market.description: Financial market MIC (XNYS, XLON, XETR, XHKG, XJPX, XSAU…) — trading/settlement calendar instead of a country.
market.title: Market

month_end_clamp.description: For months: clamp 31 Jan + 1 month to 28/29 Feb (true) or overflow into March (false).
month_end_clamp.title: Month End Clamp

period.description: Length of the period; negative counts backwards.
period.title: Period

start_date.description: ISO date the period runs from (service, invoice, filing date…).
start_date.title: Start Date

subdivision.description: Sub-national code (US 'CA', DE 'BY', AE 'DU', CA 'ON', AU 'NSW', IN 'KA'…). See list_calendars.
subdivision.title: Subdivision

weekend.description: Override the weekend, e.g. ['FRI','SAT'] or ['SUN']. Default: the country's legal weekend.
weekend.title: Weekend

name: compute_deadline
title: Compute a deadline with an explanation trail
